metadata.description: Not used, but needed to pass arm-ttk test `Location-Should-Not-Be-Hardcoded`.  We instead use the `workspace-location` which is derived from the LA workspace
[concat('Region to deploy solution resources -- separate from location selection',parameters('location'))]
Workspace name for Log Analytics where Microsoft Sentinel is setup
resource group name where Microsoft Sentinel is setup
subscription id where Microsoft Sentinel is setup
Deploy the Microsoft Sentinel analytic rules carried by this solution (ContentKind AnalyticsRule and its AnalyticsRuleTemplate registration face).
Deploy the Microsoft Sentinel workbook content and its Content Hub registration carried by this solution (ContentKind Workbook and WorkbookTemplate).
Deploy the data connectors carried by this solution, together with their metadata and catalog entries (ContentKind DataConnector, ResourceDataConnector and DataType).

Deploy the XDR-native custom detection resources and their Content Hub registrations (ContentKind CustomDetection and CustomDetectionTemplate). Independent of DeployAnalyticsRule: both kinds can be selected together. Existing analytic-rule instances are not disabled or removed. CD enabled or disabled status is controlled separately from this deployment switch.
Deploy the parsers and their registrations carried by this solution.
